text: Ɓen ɓe hattanaani resugol sabu baasal maɓɓe, yo ɓe ɗaɓɓu ɓuurnaade gaa e jina ngon haa Alla alɗinira ɓe Ɓural Makko Yaajungal ngal. Ɓen maccuɓe wonuɓe ɗaɓɓude soottaadede ka koohooɓe maɓɓe ɓen e dow yoɓugol jawdi fii yo ɓe rinɗu, no fawii koohooɓe maɓɓe ɓen jaɓanngol ɓe ɗum, si ɓe anndirii ɓe hattaneede tottugol ngol e moƴƴugol ka diina, haray no fawii ɓe nde ɓe jonnata ɓe jawdi Alla ndi O jonni ɓe ndin, ɗum woni ɓe fukkana ɓe peccun e ko ɓe winndi ɓe kon fii yoɓugol ɗum. Wata on doolu horɓe mooɗon ɓen e jeeno fii ɗaɓɓugol jawdi -wano Abdullaahi bun ubayyu waɗirnoo non horɓe makko ɓen ɗiɗo fewndo ɓe ɗaɓɓunoo nantagol e woɗɗitagol e pankare ɗen- fii yo on ɗaɓɓu ko o faggitori kon farju makko on, kala dooluɗo ɓe e mooɗon fii ɗum, pellet, Alla ɓaawo doolugol ɓe ngol ko O Surroowo junuubu maɓɓe on, Yurmeteeɗo ɓe; sabu ko ɓe doolaaɓe, bakkaatu on ko fawii ko e dooluɗo ɓe on.
